headline: Gannon have not lost since their opening match
dek: Lake Erie beat Gannon at home in their opening match, and nobody has beaten them since: they have won ten and drawn three. West Chester and Seton Hill are the conference sides who have held them level.
displaced_by: Gannon are now 10-3-1 with 41 goals, so the standing dek's seven wins and 30 goals are false; their unbeaten run since the opening defeat is now the story

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and West Chester together, and conceded 15: the tallest bar belongs to a side that keeps goals out as well as putting them in, not one trading them.

wire.line: Jaden Howard has kept seven shutouts in goal for West Chester.
